description: This file defines React components and functions for rendering and managing a list of actions in a trace viewer UI, including building action trees, rendering action details, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: ActionTreeView
classes.description: A specialized TreeView component for displaying action tree items.

methods.name: ActionList
methods.description: React component that renders a list of actions as a tree, with callbacks for selection, highlighting, and interaction.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Function that renders a visual representation of an action trace event, including duration, errors, warnings, and attachments.

methods.name: renderTitleForCall
methods.description: Function that generates a formatted title and React elements for an action call, replacing protocol parameters with formatted values.
